rounds.text: Despite headline profitability, Hindustan Zinc carries severe asset-valuation and technical risks that are unsupported by the underlying evidence [E2, E7, E50, E51]. The stock trades at an extreme price-to-book multiple of 10.09x against a sector benchmark of just 3.45x, signalling an inflated valuation that dwarfs peer levels [E2, E7]. This rich pricing comes alongside deteriorating technical momentum, with the share price sitting below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages and registering a weak relative-strength rating of 26 against the Nifty 500 [E50, E51]. Furthermore, institutional sentiment is cooling, reflected in negative money flow and a reduction in promoter holdings by 4.21 percentage points over recent periods [E41, E44]. Operational headwinds also linger beneath the surface, including unhedged cost vulnerabilities such as higher imported coal prices, lower linkage coal materialization, and recent hedge losses of INR 200 crores [E90, E99]. Conceded: the company boasts a robust return on equity track record of 68.7% over 3 years and low debt levels [E39, E61].

evidence.quote: Looking into the year ahead, with a well-structured capex roadmap in place, we are confident in sustaining this strong performance in the year ahead with an expected mined metal production of 1,150 KTPA, plus or minus 10 KT, and a refined metal production of 1,100 KTPA, plus or minus 10 KT, with an expected refined silver production of 680 tons, plus or minus 10 tons.

evidence.quote: Our other 2 key projects, that is hot acid leaching plant at Dariba and fertilizer plant at Chanderiya are on track to be completed by the second quarter of the year.

evidence.fact: Zinc cost of production excluding royalty fell 16% year-on-year to USD 851 per ton.
evidence.quote: On the cost front, despite the volatile geopolitical environment, we achieved the lowest quarterly zinc cost of production, excluding royalty, since underground transition to USD851 per ton, reflecting a decline of 16% year-on-year.

evidence.fact: Power and fuel costs increased sequentially due to lower materialization of linkage coal and higher imported coal costs.
evidence.quote: So the power and fuel cost during the quarter has dincreased majorly due to our materialization of linkage coal, which is slightly lower due to the various reasons, including the mine conditions from where we take coal.

evidence.fact: The company's EBITDA margin for the first quarter of FY27 was 59%.
evidence.quote: EBITDA margin (%) 59%

evidence.fact: Silver production reached 149 tons during the quarter, contributing 46% to overall profitability.
evidence.quote: We achieved 149 tons of silver production in line with the lead production and our silver portfolio continues to contribute 46% to overall profitability.

evidence.fact: The company monetized 10,000 tons of lead concentrate equivalent to roughly 9 tons of silver and 6,000 tons of lead metal content.
evidence.quote: During the quarter, we also monetized 10 kt of lead concentrate equivalent to approximate 9 tons of silver and 6,000 tons of lead metal content.

evidence.fact: The company crossed 1.1 million tons of mined metal and sustained over 1 million tons of refined metal production for the fourth consecutive year.
evidence.quote: This year, we set a new milestone by crossing 1.1 million tons of mined metal while sustaining over 1 million ton of refined metal production for the fourth consecutive year.

evidence.fact: Hindustan Zinc achieved a record quarterly net profit of INR 5,469 crores, up 145% year-on-year.
evidence.quote: Reflecting this strong operating performance, we delivered our record quarterly net profit of INR5,469 crores, up 145% year-on-year.

evidence.fact: The company ended the quarter with a net cash balance of INR 5,572 crores.
evidence.quote: We ended this quarter with a net cash position of INR5,572 crores, providing significant financial flexibility to pursue value-accretive growth opportunities while maintaining an attractive shareholder return profile.

evidence.fact: Hindustan Zinc paid its first interim dividend of INR 11 per share during the quarter.
evidence.quote: Reflecting our confidence in the business and strong cash generation, during the quarter, the company paid its first interim dividend of INR11 per share, reaffirming our commitment to delivering sustainable shareholder returns.

evidence.fact: Cost reduction benefits were partially offset by higher input commodity prices, particularly energy prices driven by global geopolitical crises.
evidence.quote: The reduction was driven by better grade, higher metal production, increased renewable power consumption and better by-product realization, partly offset by higher input commodity prices, especially energy prices in line with the geopolitical crisis globally.

evidence.quote: So the hedge losses are to the tune of INR200 crores.

evidence.quote: Before we begin, it is with deep sorrow that I share an unfortunate incident at our Zawar mines on 25th of January 2026, wherein we lost an employee of our business partner due to an unexpected man-machine interaction.

evidence.quote: Our other 2 key projects, that is hot acid leaching plant at Dariba and fertilizer plant at Chanderiya are on track to be completed by the second quarter of the year.

evidence.fact: Management commitment (Q1 FY28): The fertilizer plant construction is targeted to come in place by Q1 of the next financial year.
evidence.quote: Fertilizer plant should come in place by quarter 1 of next financial year.

evidence.quote: Following a thorough investigation, we are committed to disseminating learnings across the organization while implementing corrective measures and strengthening safety protocols to prevent such tragedies in future.
